title: Lorenzo Staulz, Oren's band and the Crescent Band
summary: They recall Staulz with Oren Band, King Oliver's rival band, and the Crescent Band with Celestin, Punch, the Dutrey brothers and Jim Johnson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Sure, Lorenzo used to play with me with the Rindis Tuxedo. Lorenzo used to play with Oren.
Mm-hmm.
That was Oren Band. He played with Oren Band, Lorenzo Stahl. Get the... See, King Oliver, Joe Oliver had one band. Oren had one band. That's where the book used to come up.
They'd play about the same styles.
Yes, they'd play about the same style. Mud Carey was playing on that with Oren.
Yeah, I knew Mud. Mm-hmm.
See, that's how I started getting up in music when I used to follow Jack here and Mud's brother. That was the old Crescent Band.
Mm-hmm. I've heard of that. Who was playing Cornette, do you remember?
Celestine.
Oh, in that, yeah.
Celestine was playing the Crescent Band before... Punch.
Do you remember Punch?
He played with him too later, I think. Yes, Punch played with him too.
I saw Punch just yesterday. He was by my place.
Let's see that. That's... That's Jack Carey and Charlie Moore's guitar. And... I'm looking at the fellas. There's two brothers of them, Dutres.
Oh, yeah.
Sam Dutres and his brother playing violin. They had another brother playing trombone, Nori Dutres. Mm-hmm. He left and went to Chicago. Yeah.
Yes, he made some records with Oliver up there. Yes.
And the best player was Jim Johnson. Mm-hmm. Yeah, right, eh?
Yes, he played with Bolden, somebody told me too.
He sure did. Way back there. Played with Bolden. Mm-hmm. And he played with the crescent band too.
